1. Enterprise SA Selection Decision Tree (R596)
Virtual MCU Co-Sim MCP, Animated Arch Diagrams, GSC MCP & GEO
Q1: Boardless STM32/ESP32/RP2040 Firmware CI & MCP?
• w1ne/labwired-core (★205, MIT, Rust):
Mixed-signal circuit & MCU simulator (STM32, ESP32, RP2040)
Deterministic CI + MCP server so coding agents test firmware
• Zero physical dev boards required on engineer desks
Q2: Animated Light/Dark Architecture Diagrams from YAML?
• byAbas/archgram (★7, MIT, Rust / npm `archgram`):
Define nodes & edges in JSON or YAML spec
Auto-layouts, routes orthogonal lines & draws animated flows
• Native light & dark mode output for SA architecture docs
Q3: Keyless OAuth Google Search Console MCP Server?
• AKzar1el/mcp-gsc (★8, MIT, TS, `@digestseo/mcp-gsc`):
Queries clicks, impressions, avg position, URL inspection
& sitemaps via Google OAuth (zero static API keys)
• Runs locally via npm or self-hosted on Cloudflare Workers
Q4: End-to-End Astro/Cloudflare SEO & GEO Skill Suite?
• karero/croftweaver (★11, MIT, Python):
Builds, tests & launches Astro -> GitHub -> Cloudflare sites
Enforces accessibility, schema markup & automated test gates
• Weekly Search Console + AI-answer (GEO) citation feedback loop
2. End-to-End Enterprise Hardware-Free Firmware CI, Spec-Driven Diagrams & SEO/GEO Architecture
Four-Pillar Stack: LabWired MCU Co-Sim MCP ➔ Archgram Animated Specs ➔ DigestSEO GSC MCP ➔ Croftweaver GEO Loop
Pillar A: Virtual MCU Co-Sim (w1ne/labwired-core)
• Multi-Target Silicon Simulation: Virtualizes STM32, ESP32
and RP2040 microcontrollers with mixed-signal peripherals
• Deterministic CI & Agent MCP: Coding agents compile, flash
and inspect virtual pins/registers via MCP in headless CI
• Hardware-Validated Core: Continuous Rust Core CI, Board CI
and real hardware target validation suites
• License: Permissive MIT License (★205 stars, 50 forks)
✓ Unblocks autonomous embedded firmware development in cloud CI
Pillar B: Spec-Driven Animated Diagrams (byAbas/archgram)
• Declarative JSON / YAML Input: Agents author clean node
and edge definitions without guessing pixel coordinates
• Automated Rust Layout & Routing: Computes node placement,
orthogonal line routing & animated traffic flows
• Dual Theme Output: Native light and dark mode rendering
ready for GitHub READMEs, docs & architecture decks
• Package: `archgram` on npm (Rust core, MIT License)
✓ Eliminates manual Visio/Figma line dragging for SA diagrams
Pillar C: Search Console MCP (AKzar1el/mcp-gsc)
• Full GSC Telemetry Surface: Queries clicks, impressions,
CTR, average position, URL inspection, sitemaps & indexing
• Keyless Google OAuth Security: Authenticates via standard
Google OAuth without long-lived static service-account JSONs
• Dual Deployment: Run locally via `@digestseo/mcp-gsc` on
npm or self-host remotely on Cloudflare Workers
• Registry Verified: `io.github.AKzar1el/mcp-gsc` (MIT)
✓ Feeds live organic search & indexing data directly to agents
Pillar D: Search & AI GEO Web Skills (karero/croftweaver)
• Brief-to-Production Pipeline: Guides coding agents to build
complete sites on Astro -> GitHub -> Cloudflare Workers
• Built-In Quality Gates: Mobile-first responsive checks,
accessibility validation, JSON-LD schema markup & test suites
• Closed-Loop SEO + GEO: Combines Search Console data with
weekly checks of which AI assistants cite your domain (GEO)
• License: Permissive MIT License
✓ Optimizes enterprise docs/sites for both Google & AI answers
